verdict.rationale: A live probe shows https://angular.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured, agent-readable table of contents, so an agent can be pointed at official LLM-oriented docs. The angular.dev homepage also advertises 'AI-forward resources and integrations', though it gives no specifics. Missing for 10: detail on the depth and scope of the llms.txt content (e.g. a full-text variant or per-topic agent guides), concrete documentation of the AI-oriented resources, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it effectively.
